name: Project Browser Gitlab
description: A GitLab source plugin for the Project Browser.
project_description:
Integrate Project Browser with Gitlab in order to browse (and install in the future) projects from a Gitlab instance.

 /!\ Project Browser is under active development so does this module. Don't expect a stable release before Project Browser reaches core. /!\ 

 After you installed the module, visit /admin/config/development/project_browser_gitlab to configure a new Gitlab source. Enable this new source in /admin/config/development/project_browser.

Your new source is now visible in /admin/modules/browse.
